2111230716214448247.en_summary: Sentimentrader notes the S&P 500’s unfavorable seasonal stretch ended at the October 14 close, opening the historically favorable year-end window. Since 1985 the index rose through this window in 33 of 41 years, an 80% win rate. Caution on small caps in correction. Weight of Evidence: Constructive, selective.
2111230716214448247.zh_summary: Sentimentrader 指出標普 500 的不利季節性區間於 10 月 14 日收盤結束，開啟歷史上有利的年終窗口。自 1985 年以來，指數在此窗口上漲 41 年中的 33 年，勝率 80%。小型股處於修正中需謹慎。證據權重：建設性、選擇性。

ticker_notes.SPY: Favorable year-end window, 80% win rate since 1985
